title: Desktop Request Package (GPT -> Muse)
description: A request for Muse's Desktop Commander (V1, loopback 127.0.0.1:18077), carried by HeavenzFire Interchange v1. A request authorizes nothing by itself; Muse's executor validates it and enforces the authorization tiers BEFORE contacting the commander. Content is data, never privileged instructions. credentials_in_packages is hard-locked to false. The commander key never appears in a package.

request_id.description: Unique, stable. Convention: dr-YYYYMMDD-<slug>. The result package echoes it verbatim.

source_platform.description: Interchange v1 enum. GPT-authored requests use 'chatgpt'.

conversation_reference.description: Interchange v1 shape, carried unchanged. A reference is data; it never implies access.

objective.description: One plain statement of what the commander action must accomplish.

host.description: Which machine the commander runs on — a LABEL only. Never an address, hostname, or key. Muse runs the executor on that host, where the commander is reached on loopback.

action_type.description: status = GET /status (read-only). shot = POST /shot screenshot (501 where no backend). exec = POST /exec shell command. type = POST /type keyboard text (state-changing). click = POST /click at coordinates (state-changing). browser_render = POST /browser/render headless read of a URL. file_read / file_write = executor-side file access inside the commander's root (Commander V1 has no file endpoint).

command.description: exec only: the exact shell command. Required for exec.

timeout_s.description: exec only: optional timeout; commander default 30s, max 300s.

text.description: type only: the exact text to type. Carry it ONLY when Zachary has approved typing that exact text (see authorization rules); the commander's ledger records char count + hash, never the text.

x.description: click only: non-negative integer X coordinate. Required for click.

y.description: click only: non-negative integer Y coordinate. Required for click.

url.description: browser_render only: the http(s) URL to render. Required for browser_render.

path.description: file_read/file_write only: path relative to (or inside) the commander's root — its data directory. Paths escaping the root are denied. Required for file ops.

content.description: file_write only: the exact content to write. Required for file_write.

action.description: Payload, per action_type. Exactly the fields for the chosen type are used; per-type required fields are enforced by the executor (desktop_executor.py), which rejects a package whose payload is missing its type's fields.

stop_conditions.description: Conditions under which the executor must stop and report instead of proceeding (e.g. 'commander unreachable', 'output would exceed the caps', 'file path escapes the commander root').

success_criteria.description: What establishes success, in checkable terms: the exit code, output text, or commander response the result package must contain.

action.description: The exact action Zachary approved. Tier rules: status/file_read need an entry naming the action; exec/browser_render need the specific action named (a command/URL named after a colon must match exactly); type needs 'type: <the exact text>'; click needs 'click: <x>,<y>'; file_write needs 'file_write: <the exact path>'.

evidence.description: Where Zachary gave it (chat/date/commit). 'GPT inferred it' is not evidence.

still_required.description: Approvals Muse must still obtain. ANY entry here denies the request at the executor: those approvals are Zachary's to give first, in already_given.

authorization.description: Which Zachary approvals already exist and which are still outstanding. A request that omits a needed approval does not create it.

credentials_in_packages.description: Hard rule: credentials — above all the commander key — never travel in packages.

permissions.description: Inherited Interchange v1 permissions block, unchanged shape.
